links.comparator_used: Random unit testing, LLM judges (open-weights and frontier model), and a blinded physician panel
links.outcome: Detection of safety-property violations (soundness and completeness) in clinical rule sets and state machines
links.effect: SMT verification detected all 612 violations with no false alarm and no unsound verdict. The frontier judge matched its detection but gave a sample statistic with no coverage guarantee at far higher cost. The open-weights judge produced 17 unsound verdicts on the stress tier. Unit testing and the physician panel failed on deep, cross-encounter longitudinal properties.
links.tradeoff: The guarantee holds only conditional on the specification being correct. SMT may also return an explicit abstention instead of a verdict.
links.quote: Verification was sound and complete, detecting all 612 violations with no false alarm and no unsound verdict.

design_hint: formal SMT verification of safety constraints versus unit testing, LLM judges, and physician review
